description: presentCustomerSheet before initCustomerSheet. Both platforms resolve an error instead of presenting. iOS applies the presentation and animation styles to the presenting view controller before it checks for a sheet. The timeout keys come from a second call with a sheet initialised: the delay each platform schedules the dismissal with, and that no dismissal is scheduled without a sheet.

ios.result.error.message: CustomerSheet has not been properly initialized.

android.result.error.message: No customer sheet has been initialized yet.

parityGaps.result.error.message: G9: Different wording for the same missing init.

platformOnly.presenter.animationStyle: CustomerSheetPresentParams.animationStyle is documented as iOS only.
platformOnly.timeout.result.error.code: When the timeout fires, iOS dismisses the sheet and resolves a Timeout error. Android finishes the sheet's activities and resolves whatever the sheet callback then reports, which needs a real sheet.
